description: This file 'connect.h' defines function prototypes, constants, and structures related to establishing and managing network connections, handling protocol features, and connection version discovery in a networked application, likely part of a larger version control or communication system.

methods.name: git_connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection with a remote repository given a file descriptor array, URL, name, program, and flags.

methods.name: finish_connect
methods.description: Completes and cleans up after a connection process.

methods.name: git_connection_is_socket
methods.description: Checks if the given connection is a socket.

methods.name: server_supports
methods.description: Checks if the server supports a specific feature.

methods.name: parse_feature_request
methods.description: Parses a feature request string to verify support for a feature.

methods.name: server_feature_value
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a server feature.

methods.name: url_is_local_not_ssh
methods.description: Checks if a URL points to a local resource without using SSH.

methods.name: discover_version
methods.description: Discovers the protocol version supported by the server.

methods.name: server_supports_hash
methods.description: Checks if the server supports a specific hash algorithm or feature.

methods.name: parse_feature_value
methods.description: Parses the feature list to extract the value associated with a specific feature.

methods.name: server_supports_v2
methods.description: Checks if the server supports protocol version 2.

methods.name: ensure_server_supports_v2
methods.description: Ensures that the server supports protocol version 2, possibly by checking or negotiating.

methods.name: server_feature_v2
methods.description: Retrieves the version 2 feature value from the server.

methods.name: server_supports_feature
methods.description: Checks if the server supports a specific feature, with error handling.

methods.name: check_stateless_delimiter
methods.description: Checks the stateless RPC delimiter in a protocol exchange.
